title: I spent $600 on Black Friday to make my ex jealous

voice.name: Kitty
voice.direction: sultry, smirking, brisk TikTok storytelling pace

hooks.text: Last Black Friday, I spent $600 to make my ex jealous.
My ex rated my revenge haul. One text.
Don't shop to make him jealous. I did.

hookVariants.visual: Tiff buried in shopping bags on her bed, receipt unrolling to the floor. Text hook: $600 REVENGE HAUL.
Same line and text hook; frame 0 is a tight close-up of the key prop or screen, then a fast pull-back to Tiff.
Same line and text hook; frame 0 is Tiff's face mid-reaction (eyes wide), then a whip to the key prop.

beats.text: Last Black Friday, I spent $600 to make my ex *jealous*.
beats.visual: Tiff buried in shopping bags on her bed, receipt unrolling to the floor. Text hook: $600 REVENGE HAUL.

beats.text: New dress. New boots. New bag. New *everything*.
beats.visual: Rapid outfit swaps in the mirror, three looks.

beats.text: I posted every outfit. He *viewed* every story.
beats.visual: Phone: story viewers list, Jake's name on top every time.

beats.text: Day three, he finally texted me: *nice* haul.
Then: shame you still dress for *me*.
I sat on my bedroom floor in my brand new boots and *cried*.
beats.visual: Night, Tiff on the floor among bags, mascara running.
Slow creep in on Tiff's face.

beats.text: The return window had *closed*. The tags were still on.
beats.visual: Close on dangling price tags; a receipt with 'RETURNS: 14 DAYS' crossed out.

beats.text: So I snapped the whole haul and listed it with *pileGo*.
beats.visual: Tiff photographs each piece; listings fly to app tiles.

beats.text: Got most of my money back by *Monday*.
beats.visual: Sale cards stack up; a counter climbs.

beats.text: The only outfit I kept? The one he never *saw*.
beats.visual: Tiff in a simple outfit she loves, smiling at the mirror.
